items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: We had this engagement for Sandrini -- the agency was Sandrini and Robert.

ctx.x: So it was Sandrini and Robert. We went to the Negresco for Satori, and after we finished with Satori, we went to Marseille, went to Gibraltar, and then went on to South America.
I see. That was a long trip.
